Name: Team Fortress 2 Hats (JA)
Author: ikeychain
Description:
Adds new hats inspired by the video game Team Fortress 2. Buy them from Hat Mouse. 

[list]
[*]Tyrant's Helm (RED)
[*]Tyrant's Helm (BLU)
[*]Bonk Helm (RED)
[*]Bonk Helm (BLU)
[*]Glengarry Bonnet (RED)
[*]Glengarry Bonnet (BLU)
[*]Stainless Pot
[*]Otolaryngologist's Mirror.
[/list]
